# Documentation and integration

Update all relevant documentation to reflect the new near-duplicate detection capability and wire it into existing workflows.

## Parent AC coverage

This task covers **AC6 (documentation updated)** — skill/test-churn/SKILL.md gains a Near-duplicate detection section wired into the pruning workflow, docs/dev/test-churn-skill-reference.md records method, thresholds, complexity/runtime bound, worked example and limitations, README.md skill line mentions it, docs state this analyser supersedes evaluate_usefulness.py name-marker heuristic for near-duplicates. Also covers **AC4 (performance bounded and documented)** — measured runtime figure for ~500-test-file suite recorded in docs and report preamble.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1 - Documentation is updated. skill/test-churn/SKILL.md gains a Near-duplicate detection section wired into the existing pruning workflow (step 2 inspect candidates gains the command as the evidence source for the duplicate-coverage bullet); docs/dev/test-churn-skill-reference.md records the method, thresholds, complexity/runtime bound, worked example and limitations; the README.md skill line mentions it; and the docs state that this analyser supersedes evaluate_usefulness.py name-marker heuristic for near-duplicates. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- AC2 - skill/test-churn/SKILL.md gains a Near-duplicate detection section wired into the existing pruning workflow; step 2 inspect candidates gains the command as the evidence source for the duplicate-coverage bullet.
- AC3 - docs/dev/test-churn-skill-reference.md records the method, thresholds, complexity/runtime bound, worked example, and limitations.
- AC4 - README.md test-churn skill line extended to mention near-duplicate detection.
- AC5 - skill/shared/test-writing-guidelines.md anti-pattern 4 gains the automated-evidence pointer.
- AC6 - skill/test/scripts/evaluate_usefulness.py docstring/reason cross-reference to the new tool (no behaviour change).
- AC7 - All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

## Deliverables

- skill/test-churn/SKILL.md - new section
- docs/dev/test-churn-skill-reference.md - method, thresholds, complexity, example, limitations
- README.md - test-churn bullet extended
- skill/shared/test-writing-guidelines.md - anti-pattern 4 pointer
- skill/test/scripts/evaluate_usefulness.py - docstring cross-reference
- skill/test-churn/scripts/test_duplicate_detection.py - docstrings

## Key Files

- skill/test-churn/SKILL.md
- docs/dev/test-churn-skill-reference.md
- README.md
- skill/shared/test-writing-guidelines.md
- skill/test/scripts/evaluate_usefulness.py

## Dependencies

- SA-0MWIT2PP4003JZUR (comprehensive test suite)
